TaskDescription: Alternating 1-minute eyes-open and eyes-closed resting blocks (EO-EC-EO-EC), 4 minutes total. Transitions signaled by auditory beep.
InstitutionalDepartmentName: Department of Psychology and Neuroscience and Mental Health Institute, University of Alberta
Instructions: Next, we want to record brain activity during your resting state. First, you will see a cross on the screen. Please keep your eyes open while the cross is on the screen (1 minute). You can blink your eyes during this period, but try to remain still and relaxed. After the cross disappears, please close your eyes and keep them closed before you hear a beep (1 minute). Again, try to remain still and relaxed. You will do 2 rounds of the eyes open/eyes closed states.
